title: morning_report_input/v1
description: The step input that the host writes to .baltor/step/input.json before launch. Every path is relative to the workspace root. The report and notes paths lie inside .baltor/, outside .baltor/step/ and outside the handoff folder.

night_id.description: A name for the night, such as its date.

handoff_dir.description: The folder that holds the night's night_step_handoff/v1 files, read with every folder below it.

activity_log_dir.description: A folder of JSON Lines activity logs, or null when the night kept none.

activity_fields.description: The names of the time field and the step field in one activity line.

queue_path.description: The night's queue, or null. Either an object whose tickets list holds {ticket_id, final_step_id}, or a night_queue/v1 record whose items hold {id, final_step_id}. final_step_id is optional and names the step whose complete handoff finishes the ticket; without it the ticket stays unfinished in the report.

notes_path.description: Where the report step may write its notes. The file may not exist.

output_path.description: A path inside .baltor/ and outside .baltor/step/, the packet folder that the step only reads.
